description: CAIDE dementia risk score. Takes midlife risk factors (age, years of education, sex, systolic blood pressure, BMI, total cholesterol, physical activity) as CSV and returns the 0-15 CAIDE score, a risk category, and estimated 20-year risk of dementia. Deterministic score (Kivipelto 2006). Complements white-matter/small-vessel burden from a WMH segmentation model.
disease: dementia, dementia risk, cognitive decline, Alzheimer, small vessel disease, midlife risk
